The Women's skeet event at the 2020 Summer Olympics took place on 25 and 26 July 2021 at the Asaka Shooting Range.[1]

Records

Prior to this competition, the existing world and Olympic records were as follows.

Qualification records
World record  Wei Meng (CHN)124 Doha, Qatar10 November 2019
Olympic record Not established– ––
Final records
World record  Wei Meng (CHN)59 Al Ain, United Arab Emirates12 October 2019
Olympic record Not established– ––

During the competition, Wei Meng established a new Olympic record (124) in qualification, and Amber English in the finals (56).

From 1972 to 1992, the skeet event was open to both men and women. Zhang Shan won this event in 1992, the only woman to do so.
